sources.title: GitHub - abylaydospayev/crop_classifier
sources.snippet: This project builds a deep learning-based classifier to identify agricultural crops from images. A fine-tuned ResNet-50 model is used as the core classifier, with Grad-CAM visual explanations and an interactive Gradio demo for real-time predictions.

sources.title: GitHub - harshitads28/Crop-Classifier
sources.snippet: The model is trained on the Popular 139 Crops Image Dataset and deployed as an interactive web application using Streamlit. The system enables automated crop recognition, supporting applications in: Smart agriculture Agricultural AI systems
